en: A sepia-toned photographic portrait postcard featuring a woman draped in a light, classical garment with her arms crossed, looking pensively at the camera. The background is plain and the photograph has a formal studio quality. Below the image, the name 'HENNY PORTEN' appears in uppercase letters, along with photographer and publisher marks on the bottom left and right corners.
